choices.C01: Every row enters every statistic; no row of any piece (B1 included) has resid_flag true, so this changes no number.
choices.C02: Rows of a region are averaged, then regions averaged with weight 1 each; on a draw a region drawn k times weighs k (cluster bootstrap).
choices.C03: The signed mean uses the same region weights as I_m(j), on signed phi.
choices.C04: j is in J iff some model has I_m(j) > 1e-12 x (sum of I_m over all its players), I the region-weighted mean |phi|; strict '>'; a zero total adds nothing.
choices.C05: 'Some model' = every model of per_lead.json models (cross-link and declined included); one J per level for every statistic of the problem.
choices.C06: A name with no column in a model's file is 0 on every row for that model (ranked as 0, ties by name); structural zeros = union of names minus J.
choices.C07: J (and its 200-player test) and B1's pair J fixed at the full sample; top-k sets and their unions found again on each draw; determined signs fixed from the full bootstrap.
choices.C08: Counts recomputed per draw get intervals (n_nonzero, n_nonzero_before_merge, sign_n_determined, sign_n_agree); n_J has none (J fixed).
choices.C09: Nonzero = I_m(j) > 0 exactly (some row nonzero), counted over the model's own columns; per draw on that draw's I.
choices.C10: Ties = exact float64 equality of I_m; name = result name (x__/c__ kept) in ascending Python order; one strict order (I desc, name asc) for top-k, RBO, top-10/top-3.
choices.C11: Spearman = Pearson of average ranks; over the top-20 union the two I vectors are re-ranked within the union.
choices.C12: A top-k set has min(k,|J|) names; the top-20 Jaccard only when the full-sample J (B1: pair J) has >= 200 players, else null.
choices.C13: RBO = (1-p) sum_{d=1..n} p^(d-1) A_d + p^n A_n over the two full strict rankings of J (eq. 32 with s = l = n); self-RBO = 1.
choices.C14: TV = half the sum of absolute differences of the shares over J; family TV the same over the families present.
choices.C15: Family row attribution = sum of all its variables' phiv; family share = region-weighted mean |sum| over the five families' total; variable level only; absent family null.
choices.C16: Named families first (hist_*, normal, calendar/ctx:*), then the rule (every column one exact value per time across all test-set units), else local drivers.
choices.C17: Determined iff ci_low > 0 or ci_high < 0 (strict); sign agreement = n_agree / n_determined on the top-10 union, undefined when n_determined = 0.
choices.C18: Undefined (null on the full sample, NaN on a draw): all-tied rankings, no determined player, zero totals, fewer than 2 main models, no rival (fire), no hist_* variable (coral).
choices.C19: W over J with average ranks and T = sum(t^3 - t) per rater; mean pairwise Spearman = mean of the main set's Spearman over J, computed directly.
choices.C20: Stability = mean over finite draws of Spearman over J between full-sample I and the draw's I; no interval (counts and percentiles in extra).
choices.C21: numpy percentile 2.5/97.5 (linear interpolation) of the finite replicates; non-finite dropped and counted; interval whenever n_finite >= 1.
choices.C22: Rivals = main set minus treeroute; median by numpy (even count: mean of the middle two), CI from per-draw medians; range = min and max, each with per-draw CI.
choices.C23: Median of the rivals' own-history shares, recomputed per draw; median_rival_name only for an odd count.
choices.C24: Own-history share = the own-history family share (sum of hist_* phiv per row), not the sum of hist_* shares.
choices.C25: All arcsine-link models of all problems (coral 4, fire treeroute); their pre > 0 rows; I, share, S, sign, n_nonzero, ranking, top-10 over the variable J; regions without such rows drop out.
